title: Trading-cycle audit continuation: real-cycle validation of released revision 0bfdb438
fix_commit: f9cb6c34 (branch fix/financial-rules-contract-fields, NOT merged, NOT deployed)
gap_that_prompted_this: Every financial source file, and the validation script itself, changed after the last real-cycle run (aapl-cycle-r4), and r4 FAILED. The release was validated only against synthetic fixtures and the unit suite.

finding_decision_synthesizer_contract.severity: live defect on the deployed revision
finding_decision_synthesizer_contract.claim: FINANCIAL_OUTPUT_RULES replaces the agent OUTPUT section whenever financial_evidence_version==1 (set unconditionally at orchestrator.py:3264) and enumerates required fields WITHOUT the decision contract's board-linkage fields, which arrive only in the ~48k-char user message. The model reads the system list as exhaustive and omits them, so the Decision Synthesizer fails contract_errors every cycle and the orchestrator falls back to the Board verdict.
errors: source_board_ref must match the current Board artifact
source_board_action must match the current Board action
decision_relation must be preserve or override

production_exposure.note: No production cycle has yet run under the deployed revision; the next one would be the first.

finding_decision_synthesizer_contract.cost_when_it_fires: four synthesizer calls per ticker (attempt+repair, twice) before the Board fallback

finding_case03_repair.claim: The remaining case03 repair failure is a FLAKY degenerate repetition loop, not a token limit and not a stable property of the prompt.

ruled_out.context_window: nemotron35 max_model_len=128000 (queried live); payload ~8.9k prompt + 8192 max output
ruled_out.harness_vs_production_max_tokens: _safe_max_tokens returns 8192 for this exact payload, identical to the benchmark

finding_case03_repair.zero_usage_signal: usage.outputTokens==0 correlated perfectly with truncated/invalid output in 8 of 8 trials, and a real count appeared in every completed one. Zero usage is a detectable failure signal, not merely unavailable telemetry.
finding_case03_repair.no_stop_reason: The prism-proxy response envelope carries no finish/stop reason field (keys: conversationId, estimatedCost, finalText, model, provider, text, thinking, usage).

limitations: Two real-cycle runs, one ticker (AAPL), stored data, all agent tools disabled.
Both cycles produced questions_required=0, so compound-question coverage was NOT exercised in a real cycle.
Both cycles ended HOLD; acceptance does not demonstrate investment merit.
The staging harness posts directly to prism-proxy; the FIRM_CONTEXT prefix was tested separately and changed nothing.
tiktoken is absent from the local .venv (pinned in requirements, present in the container), so local context budgeting uses the 4 chars/token heuristic.
The fix is committed on a branch only. It is NOT merged and NOT deployed.
